description: A directory group's access to an AWS Transfer Family server whose identity provider is a directory, made with CreateAccess. AWS has no call that removes HomeDirectoryMappings or PosixProfile from an access, so a deploy that removes one fails before any change.

HomeDirectoryMapEntry.description: A path the group's users see, and the Amazon S3 or Amazon EFS path it shows.

Target.description: The Amazon S3 or Amazon EFS path the entry shows.

Type.description: FILE for a target that is a file, or DIRECTORY, AWS's default, for a directory.

PosixProfile.description: The POSIX identity the group's users have on Amazon EFS file systems.

ExternalId.description: The security identifier (SID) of the directory group, such as S-1-1-12-1234567890-123456789-1234567890-1234.

Role.description: The ARN of the IAM role that gives the group's users access to the Amazon S3 bucket or Amazon EFS file system.

HomeDirectory.description: The directory the users land in when they sign in, such as /bucket_name/home/mydirectory.

HomeDirectoryType.description: PATH, AWS's default, to show the users Amazon S3 or Amazon EFS paths as they are, or LOGICAL to show them HomeDirectoryMappings.

HomeDirectoryMappings.description: The paths the users see, when HomeDirectoryType is LOGICAL.

Policy.description: A session policy, as JSON, that scopes down the role's access for the users. Amazon EFS doesn't use it.
